# Which screens to photograph, and in which appearance.
#
# Edit this file and commit — the Preview screens workflow runs on the change and
# posts the shots into its job log (and as artifacts). GitHub's web editor works
# fine from a phone.
#
# screens:    studio, home, archive, course, summit, yearbook, prints, wall-art,
#             map-studio, gallery-studio, detail, components, bag
#             wall-art accepts a style: wall-art:grid, wall-art:ridgeline, wall-art:rings,
#             wall-art:thread, wall-art:strata
#             timeline accepts a scope: timeline:years, timeline:months, timeline:all,
#             timeline:gallery
#             print-engine runs the print writer's self-check and reports pass/fail
# appearance: light, dark, or both
#             wall-art accepts a style: wall-art:grid, wall-art:ridgeline, wall-art:rings,
#             wall-art:thread, wall-art:strata
#             timeline accepts a scope: timeline:years, timeline:months, timeline:all,
#             timeline:gallery
#             print-engine runs the print writer's self-check and reports pass/fail
# appearance: light, dark, or both
#
# Requested for b515: does the map draw its routes on first load?
#
#   home — the regression report is that lines and pins are missing when the app opens and
#   appear once you leave the tab and come back. The cause is b513's derived-data cache: the
#   map redraws when a revision integer advances, that integer was bumped by an `onChange` on
#   the cache's *inputs*, and `onChange` without `initial:` does not fire on first appearance —
#   so the map was handed an empty set at revision 0, then the real set at revision 0, and
#   skipped the rebuild. The bump moved to the rebuild itself.
#
#   This preview reproduces the exact sequence: the harness seeds its history in a task, so
#   HomeView appears against an empty store and the data arrives a moment later, the same way a
#   cold launch does. Routes on screen means fixed.
#
# screens: a product tile can be named directly, e.g. studio@lithograph

screens=home
appearance=both
